'''Endrigorn''' was a [[Rakririan]] dealer who dealt in [[light sculpture]]s, [[Holographic art|holo-art]] and precious gems.<ref name="twilight" />

As a Rakririan, his role was a drone, a facilitator between [[Gender/Legends|male]] and female Rakririans.<ref name="twilight" />
